def record_usage(state, key, model, tokens) do
  new_state = Map.put(state, "calls", Map.get(state, "calls", []) ++ [%{"key" => key, "model" => model, "tokens" => tokens}])
  {usage(new_state, key), new_state}
end

def usage(state, key) do
  state |> Map.get("calls", []) |> Enum.filter(fn c -> c["key"] == key end) |> Enum.reduce(0, fn c, s -> s + c["tokens"] end)
end
def set_price(state, model, cents), do: {cents, Map.put(state, "prices", Map.put(Map.get(state, "prices", %{}), model, cents))}

def cost(state, key) do
  prices = Map.get(state, "prices", %{})

  cents =
    state
    |> Map.get("calls", [])
    |> Enum.filter(fn c -> c["key"] == key end)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn c, s -> s + c["tokens"] / 1000 * Map.get(prices, c["model"], 0) end)

  round(cents) / 100
end

def top_spender(state) do
  state
  |> Map.get("calls", [])
  |> Enum.map(fn c -> c["key"] end)
  |> Enum.uniq()
  |> Enum.sort()
  |> Enum.reduce(nil, fn k, best -> if best == nil or cost(state, k) > cost(state, best), do: k, else: best end)
end
